note: The flag registry: every story variable that is not a declared stat (stats.json), a person field (<id>.name, .gender, .alias, .surname from people.json), or a scratch variable starting with an underscore. kind is flag (true or unset), enum (one of values), number, or text. book is where it is decided. major: true records it in the decision log for journals and callbacks. default is the value a quick start uses when it skips that book. A name ending in .* covers a family of variables. npm run check rejects variables that are not registered, so misspellings are caught.
